title: CloudWatch alarms (thresholds, composite, and anomaly detection)
hook: CloudWatch alarms watch metrics and notify when thresholds breach. Good alarms page humans on customer impact; bad alarms train teams to ignore pages. Composite and anomaly detection reduce noise.

blocks.text: Alarms have states: OK, ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Static threshold compares metric to value over evaluation periods. Metric math combines multiple metrics. Composite alarms AND/OR child alarms. Anomaly detection bands adapt to seasonality. Actions target SNS, Auto Scaling, or EventBridge.

blocks.text: Pager fatigue kills on-call effectiveness. Alarm on SQS depth without age misses stuck single message. Alarm on raw errors without normalization pages every traffic dip. Composite alarms fire only when multiple symptoms align.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: alarm on symptoms (age, error rate). Composite reduces noise. INSUFFICIENT_DATA treat-missing-as for new services. OK action for recovery notification.

sections.heading: How it works step by step

items.title: Define SLO symptom
items.body: Queue lag > 2 min, error rate > 5%, DLQ > 0.

items.title: Pick metric and statistic
items.body: Maximum for age; metric math for rate.

items.title: Wire action and runbook
items.body: SNS to PagerDuty with runbook URL in description.

diagram.title: Composite alarm logic
diagram.source:
flowchart TD
  A1[Age > 120s] --> C{Composite AND}
  A2[Error rate > 5%] --> C
  C -->|both ALARM| PAGE[PagerDuty]
  C -->|either OK| OK[No page]

snippet.label: CloudFormation — SQS age alarm
snippet.code:
Resources:
  QueueLagAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: orders-queue-lag
      AlarmDescription: 'Runbook: https://wiki.example.com/sqs-lag'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: orders
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 120
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
snippet.explanation: 3 consecutive minutes above 120s pages. OKActions notify recovery.

snippet.label: CloudFormation — composite alarm
snippet.code:
CompositeCustomerImpact:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: payment-customer-impact
      AlarmRule: ALARM(QueueLagAlarm) AND ALARM(ErrorRateAlarm)
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref PagerDutyTopic
snippet.explanation: Pages only when both lag and errors — reduces false positives from either alone.

snippet.label: CLI — create anomaly detection alarm
snippet.code:
aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm \
  --alarm-name lambda-invocations-anomaly \
  --comparison-operator LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold \
  --evaluation-periods 2 \
  --metrics '[{"Id":"m1","ReturnData":true,"MetricStat":{"Metric":{"Namespace":"AWS/Lambda","MetricName":"Invocations","Dimensions":[{"Name":"FunctionName","Value":"payment-processor"}]},"Period":300,"Stat":"Sum"}}]' \
  --threshold-metric-id ad1 \
  --alarm-actions arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123:alerts
snippet.explanation: Anomaly band adapts to daily traffic pattern — useful post-deploy regression detection.

snippet.label: CLI — test alarm state
snippet.explanation: Verify alarm not stuck INSUFFICIENT_DATA before relying on it in prod.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Single period alarm — flapping. INSUFFICIENT_DATA on new service means silent. No OK action — team does not know recovery. Alarm on Invocations drop Monday morning without anomaly band.

blocks.text: How to prove it in production: synthetic canary triggers alarm in staging monthly. Alarm history shows state transitions. Use treat-missing-data: breaching for critical DLQ alarm so zero messages still evaluates. EventBridge alarm state change triggers auto-remediation runbook Lambda.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Saying 'alarm on every Lambda error.' Strong answer: error rate threshold, composite with lag, DLQ any-message pages, runbook in description.

interviewTakeaways: Alarm states: OK, ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA — configure treat-missing-data deliberately.
Composite alarms reduce noise — combine lag AND error rate for customer impact.
Metric math for error rate; Maximum for queue age; anomaly for seasonal traffic.
60s: Age SLA alarm. Error rate math. Composite AND. DLQ threshold zero. Runbook in description.
Follow-up: EventBridge on alarm state for auto-remediation?
commonPitfalls: Raw error count alarm — pages on low traffic noise.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA treated as OK on critical DLQ alarm.
No OK action — team unaware of recovery.
